correctness.rationale: Every projective F2-anticanonical section is one of 63 binary cubic forms in a six-dimensional space. Chartwise exact Groebner-basis unit ideal tests yield precisely masks 7,22,38,49,51,53 as geometrically smooth. Direct tangent-direction incidence identifies every one of 15 rational surface points with one of the 15 pairs of curves. For masks 7 and 22, factor F+G=X(XY+Z^2) and exact restrictions give local plane intersection orders 6,1,1,1 at the base points; subtracting 1 at each blowup produces one intersection of multiplicity 5. The computed S5 action is transitive on unordered smooth pairs, extending this to every pair. The six masks form no F2-projective line. Independent extension-field testing detects singularities in all other 57 forms. All computations are finite and complete by ideal criteria; independent external audit remains absent.

value.rationale: This classifies the complete rational anticanonical Bertini locus of the uniquely split quintic del Pezzo surface over the smallest finite field, and reveals intrinsic structure: six maximal elliptic divisors realize K6 on all 15 rational surface points, with their full degree-five intersections concentrated at those points. The sharp obstruction to any all-smooth anticanonical pencil and the sharply three-transitive S5 orbit refine existing surface and automorphism classifications, rather than an arbitrary isolated parameter slice.
